description: Reordered the MLP constructor logic to align with `CausalSelfAttention`'s internal parameter ordering (`self.mlp(norm(x))`), fixing the initialization mismatch where `self.x` and `self.x0` were incorrectly assigned to forward pass parameters instead of the class dictionary `self.resid_lambdas`. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step and crash the loop, restoring the val_bpb to 0.9912 and eliminating the crash.
